title: Managing Anxiety
author: Dr. Maria Lopez
description: Learn effective ways to reduce stress and anxiety.
content: Anxiety affects millions of people worldwide. Practicing mindfulness, breathing exercises, regular sleep schedules, and therapy sessions can greatly improve emotional regulation and reduce stress symptoms.

title: Healthy Sleep Habits
author: Dr. Carlos Vega
description: Improve mental health through better sleep routines.
content: Healthy sleep habits include reducing screen time before bed, maintaining consistent sleeping hours, avoiding caffeine late at night, and creating a calm sleep environment.

title: Understanding Depression
author: Dr. Ana Ruiz
content: Depression is a serious mental health condition that can affect mood, energy, and daily functioning. Professional counseling, emotional support, healthy routines, and therapy can significantly improve recovery outcomes.
